messages.content: Great! I’m excited to talk about enhancing the university student portal. To start off, could you share your high-level goals for this enhancement? What are you hoping to achieve with the new features?

Yeah, I mean, the portal is just kinda frustrating to use right now. I really want to make the timetable easier to read and use. It’s a bit of a mess as it is. Also, it would be great to get notifications when grades are out, so I'm not checking all the time. And I think it would be super helpful to have a way to give feedback on the modules after they’re done. That way, we can actually say what we think!

Thanks for sharing that! It sounds like you’re looking for a more user-friendly experience with the timetable, along with timely updates for grades and a way to provide feedback. 

Let’s dive a bit deeper into each of those areas. Starting with the timetable, what specific changes or features would you like to see to make it easier to read and use?

Um, well, it would be nice if we could, like, colour-code the modules or something. That way, it’s easier to see which ones are which at a glance. Also, maybe if we could hide classes that are canceled, that would help a lot. Oh, and being able to add in personal study times would be pretty useful too, just to keep everything in one place.

Those are some great ideas! So, just to clarify, you’re looking for the ability to color-code modules for easier identification, the option to hide canceled classes, and a feature to add personal study times to the timetable. 

Now, moving on to grade notifications, how would you like to receive those updates? For example, do you prefer push notifications, emails, or something else?

Yeah, I think push notifications would be really good, but emails are fine too. I just want to know as soon as my grades are posted, so I’m not refreshing the page all the time. It would be nice if it’s quick, like, within a few minutes after they’re up.

Got it! So, you’d like to receive push notifications or emails as soon as grades are posted, ideally within a few minutes, so you don’t have to keep refreshing the page. 

Now, let’s talk about the module feedback system. What specific features or aspects would you like to have in place for providing feedback on modules? For example, do you envision a simple rating system, or do you want a more detailed feedback form?

I think a simple way to give feedback would be good. Like, maybe just a quick form where we can rate things, you know? And maybe a box to write some comments too if we have specific stuff to say. Just something easy to fill out after the classes are done. It would be nice to share our thoughts without having to jump through a bunch of hoops.

That makes a lot of sense! So, you’re looking for a simple feedback form with a rating system and an optional comment box for additional thoughts, which should be easy to fill out after classes. 

To summarize what we’ve discussed so far: 
1. Personalised timetable management with color-coding, hiding canceled classes, and the ability to add personal study times.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications or emails that alert students within a few minutes after grades are posted.
3. A structured module feedback system featuring a simple rating form and a comment box for additional feedback.

Now, are there any limitations or restrictions we should be aware of while implementing these enhancements?

Um, I haven’t really thought about any limitations or anything like that. I just know that these changes would make things way better for us. I guess it’s important that it all works smoothly with the portal and doesn’t make it slower or anything, but I’m not sure about the technical stuff. I just want it to be simple and helpful!

That’s totally understandable! It’s important that the enhancements integrate smoothly with the existing portal and maintain performance. 

So, to wrap up what we have so far:
1. Personalised timetable management with color-coding, hiding canceled classes, and the ability to add personal study times.
2. Automated grade notifications via push notifications or emails that alert students within a few minutes after grades are posted.
3. A structured module feedback system featuring a simple rating form and a comment box for additional feedback.
4. Ensure that all enhancements work smoothly with the existing portal infrastructure without affecting performance.

Thank you for your insights! If there’s anything else you think of later, feel free to reach out.
